documentation_page.title: Verify webhook signatures | ParcelHook API
documentation_page.body: Verify the X-ParcelHook-Signature header against the raw request body before processing an event. Use the current endpoint secret from your dashboard. The Node.js example below includes a timing-safe comparison. Reject requests older than five minutes and store event IDs to avoid duplicate processing. See the runnable example and replay test below.
documentation_page.credit: Maintained by ParcelHook engineering; corrections: docs@parcelhook.example
